content: Intl.DateTimeFormat with timeZone: 'Asia/Seoul' (or locale en-CA for ISO YYYY-MM-DD output) reliably derives the Asia/Seoul calendar date from a UTC Date in Node/Next.js without any date library. South Korea has used a fixed UTC+9 offset with no DST since 1988, so this can safely be modeled as a constant +9h offset for date-only arithmetic.
